articles.title: MSSN Lagos names new leadership and outlines priorities for students
articles.summary: The Lagos area unit of the Muslim Students’ Society of Nigeria has inaugurated new leaders under Dr Ajibola Salami, who said the focus would be educational advancement, youth empowerment, moral development, leadership training and mentorship.
body: Voice of Nigeria reported on 24 June 2026 that the Lagos State Area unit of the Muslim Students’ Society of Nigeria (MSSN) held a press briefing after inaugurating its new leadership. The new Amir, Dr Ajibola Salami, said the team would concentrate on educational advancement, youth empowerment, moral development, leadership training, mentorship, and protecting the rights and welfare of Muslim students in Lagos State.

On education, the society welcomed the Federal Government’s Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) and asked authorities to invest more in educational infrastructure, research, innovation, scholarships and bursaries, noting that many young Nigerians struggle to access quality education.
The briefing also covered national security and the 2027 elections. This summary focuses on the education and student-welfare points, so read the full report at the source for the complete statement.

articles.title: Muslim students’ body urges new JAMB registrar to prioritise transparency and integrity
articles.summary: The Lagos chapter of the Muslim Students’ Society of Nigeria has urged Prof Segun Aina, the new registrar of the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board, to build on the work of his predecessor, Prof Ishaq Oloyede.
body: The Gazette reported on 4 August 2026 that MSSN Lagos issued a statement urging the new JAMB registrar, Prof Segun Aina, to keep improving examination processes, with transparency and integrity as priorities.

The society also acknowledged the service of Prof Ishaq Oloyede, saying his work had advanced educational assessment and strengthened confidence in Nigeria’s admissions system. This is our summary of a third-party report. See the source for the full statement.

opportunities.title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/28
opportunities.provider: UK Government (Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
opportunities.summary: A UK-government-funded scholarship for study in the UK.
opportunities.eligibility: Set by Chevening. Check the official eligibility criteria and your country page before applying.
opportunities.benefits: See the official site for exactly what is covered.
opportunities.deadline: 6 October 2026, 11:00 UTC (12:00 noon in Nigeria). Applications are now closed.
opportunities.notes: According to Chevening’s published timeline, applications opened on 4 August 2026 and closed on 6 October 2026. Dates for the next cycle have not been checked.

opportunities.title: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships 2027/28
opportunities.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
opportunities.summary: UK government scholarships for full-time taught master’s study in the UK, for candidates from eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries.
opportunities.eligibility: Candidates apply through a nominating body. The CSC does not accept direct applications for these scholarships.
opportunities.benefits: See the official page for what the award covers.
opportunities.deadline: Not confirmed in the official text we checked. Third-party sources report 20 October 2026 at 16:00 BST, which has passed.
opportunities.notes: The official page confirms applications for 2027/28 opened and that outcomes are expected by July 2027. Nominating agencies can set earlier deadlines. Check the official page for the current status.

opportunities.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28
opportunities.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
opportunities.summary: Scholarships for study in the UK beginning in September or October 2027.
opportunities.eligibility: Only applicants from the eligible countries listed on the official page can apply. Check whether your country is listed. Candidates must also apply and secure admission to a UK university course.
opportunities.benefits: See the official page for what is covered.
opportunities.deadline: Applications open on Tuesday 10 November 2026. The closing date was not shown in the text we checked.
opportunities.notes: Applications are made through CSC Central and cannot be edited after submitting.
